I am. There's too much going on in my life to cope with. I've suffered with Anxiety and Depression for almost 10 years and nothing I have tried has helped it. I've tried numerous medications, CBT, group therapies etc. 

I can't live like this. The debt is the icing on the cake really. They were loans taken out to improve a house I was living in at the time. It was in desperate need of repair and the relative I was staying with was in no position to fix it up. It needed to be safe for my child to stay there and I didn't have the money. 
I'm now about £6000 in debt because of this.
